name: Fairmont Chateau Laurier
positioning: Historic château-style Fairmont hotel (Fairmont Château Laurier) in downtown Ottawa, next to the Parliament Buildings
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown Ottawa base beside Parliament and the Rideau Canal locks
Guests who like a private Fairmont Gold lounge, an indoor pool and afternoon tea

facts.text: The hotel is in Ottawa's downtown core, between ByWard Market and the Rideau Canal locks.
The hotel is located next to the Parliament Buildings and dates from 1912.
Fairmont Gold guests get a private check-in and a lounge with breakfast and evening canapes.
The Presidential suite has a dining room that seats eight.
Guests have complimentary access to the health club, and Relax Luxe Spa offers massage.
The hotel's dining venues are Zoe's and La Terrasse.
Deluxe rooms are open-concept with a sitting and sleeping area and are described as ideal for families.
The hotel accepts cats and dogs for an additional fee.

highlights.text: The building resembles a French château made of granite blocks, with a copper roof and a marble staircase in the lobby.
Fairmont View rooms look onto Canada's Parliament Buildings and the Rideau Canal Locks.
The hotel has an indoor art-deco pool on its lower level.
Zoe's serves afternoon tea with English scones, open-faced sandwiches and sweets, paired with LOT 35 teas.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes that the heritage building may have older room configurations.
Pets are accepted for a fee but are not allowed in the hotel restaurants or lounges.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning and prime location.
